# AMBRE -- FOUNDATIONS FEATURE INVENTORY

**Type:** Inventory (generated)

> What the shared layer does today, one row per feature document. The roadmap holds what is
> left to do; this holds what is. Generated by `scripts/feature_inventory.py` from the
> documents themselves, so it carries no fact of its own.

**Do not edit this file.** Edit the feature document and run `just inventory-write`.

* **State** is derived from the contract rows, in the vocabulary of
  `ambre-spec-template.md` section 4. It is `implemented` when no row is unbuilt,
  `design-only` when none is built. The table is ordered by it, then by name.
* **Loose** counts built rows that nothing green holds: `failing`, `human-review`.
